verdict.rationale: Semgrep supports autonomous background automation through CI/CD triggers, pre-commit hooks, and managed scans, and even ships an official MCP server intended for AI-agent integration plus a documented AppSec Platform API. However, hands-on probing found the MCP server failed to initialize (McpError, no serverInfo) despite a working local CLI, and community reports note LLMs hallucinating Semgrep usage, suggesting agentic/AI-driven automation is not yet reliably turnkey.
